description: Takes a base voltage and a spread amount and gives eleven voltages spaced evenly around the base

params.text: Attenuverter for the base voltage, -1 to +1; with the base input empty it works on an internal 10V, so the knob alone sets the base anywhere from -10V to +10V
Attenuverter for the spread voltage, -1 to +1; with the spread input empty it works on an internal 5V, so the knob alone sets a spread of up to 5V either way
ODD spaces the outputs so that the base value is one of the series; EVEN spaces them so they fall either side of the base without landing on it

inputs.text: The voltage everything is spread around, scaled by the BASE attenuverter
Sets how far the outputs are spread from the base, scaled by the SPREAD attenuverter; 5V here with a 0V base puts the outputs 1V apart from -5V to +5V

outputs.text: Above the base by a share of the spread, the smallest step at SUM 1 and the full spread amount at SUM 5
Carries the base voltage on its own, with no spread applied
Below the base by a share of the spread, the smallest step at DIFF 1 and the full spread amount at DIFF 5

notes: every output is clamped to the range -10V to +10V
this module is monophonic: only the first channel of a polyphonic cable is read, and every output carries a single channel
